affinity.notes: The restrained bone, iron, and gold palette avoids a dominant elemental read.

anatomy.notes: The stacked rib structures and skull-like shoulder mass make the upper torso and right arm attachment hard to parse.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "armored melee duelist" does not semantically communicate Ossuary-Levy Interceptor (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Heavy armor and a single long blade clearly advertise a deliberate close-range threat.

finish.notes: Armor, bone, and cloth surfaces are crisp and consistently rendered.

framing.notes: Full silhouette, sword, and grounded stance read clearly with useful breathing room.

identity.notes: Blind perception "skeletal knight or undead warlord" semantically identifies skeletons/skeleton-bone-knight.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "elite" is accepted for intended T3 under the documented v2 normalization.
